cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Exactly Within Policy
cards.instruction: Agree to every request only after interpreting the policy so it grants you authority, protection, or an exemption.

mechanism: A treats hosting and supervising its cooking pupil as sufficient shared effort under the family rule, agreeing while exempting itself from kitchen work.
confusable: Not simply being lazy or asking B a favor: A first interprets the shared-effort rule to count its role instead of the requested work.
comparison: Volunteer seniority protection versus host and teaching credit as cooking exemption.
